100	#### Querying implicit many-to-many
101	
102	```ts
103	// Create post with categories
104	const post = await prisma.post.create({
105	  data: {
106	    title: "How to become a butterfly",
107	    categories: {
108	      create: [{ name: "Magic" }, { name: "Butterflies" }],
109	    },
110	  },
111	});
112	
113	// Get posts with categories
114	const posts = await prisma.post.findMany({
115	  include: { categories: true },
116	});
117	```
118	
119	#### Rules for implicit m-n
120	
121	- Both models must have a single `@id` (no composite IDs or `@unique`)
122	- No `@relation` attribute needed (unless disambiguating)
123	- Cannot use `fields`, `references`, `onUpdate`, or `onDelete` in `@relation`
124
